modernspace.create_world_plot.campus_ae: AE · The heart of the campus
modernspace.create_world_plot.campus_ae_: A central 160-block court and four open production courts. Plan your AE controller, storage, crafting CPUs, patterns and terminals; cable galleries run below the center.
modernspace.create_world_plot.campus_atl: The open AE courtyard anchors the center; modern roads join the production islands.
Scroll to zoom · Drag to pan · Point at a bay to inspect
modernspace.create_world_plot.campus_aut: This campus uses authored roads, walks and planting. Switch back to free plots on Layout to customize repeating streets.
modernspace.create_world_plot.campus_con: The ground border extends one block beyond each machine. A sea lantern marks the controller with its machine name above; tall support frames are optional and off by default.
modernspace.create_world_plot.campus_des: A planned floating campus with %s dedicated large-structure bays; small machines share the central production courts. Void beyond the islands, generated on demand.
modernspace.create_world_plot.campus_dis: Early bays sit nearest the core, with mid and late districts farther out. Blocks follow a shared grid and mirrored road axes, joined by planted walks and real-water gardens.
modernspace.create_world_plot.campus_fra: Adds tall corner posts and a top beam to estimate a giant structure's height. The one-block ground border remains when disabled. Off by default.
modernspace.create_world_plot.campus_mat: Vanilla concrete, quartz, stairs, timber, leaves and real water shape the roads and gardens. Only decoration and signs are placed; build your own machines.
modernspace.create_world_plot.campus_pre: A forest-park preset dimension with every megastructure location already marked.
modernspace.create_world_plot.custom_blo: Set ground, plot edge, road, curb and lane markings independently. Only stable solid blocks are supported.
modernspace.create_world_plot.factory_ae: A central 160-block AE hub and four shared production halls leave room for storage, crafting, small machines and passive lines. Cross-shaped cable galleries run beneath the center.
modernspace.create_world_plot.factory_au: Quartz Works uses its own authored roads, halls and machine bays. Selecting a preset preserves all private dimensions already created.
modernspace.create_world_plot.factory_co: Virtual markers locate machine controllers; build the machines yourself. Upgrades share the largest bay, attached modules count only in their host's full envelope, and halls preserve maintenance and overhead clearance.
modernspace.create_world_plot.factory_de: A complete 2000×2000 factory island with %s reserved machine bays. Production lines occupy halls grouped by tier and process; very large megastructures use open works courts. Void beyond the island; generated on demand.
modernspace.create_world_plot.factory_di: Steam, ore processing, metallurgy, chemistry, precision assembly, power and endgame megastructures are grouped by their tier and process, connected by main factory roads.
modernspace.create_world_plot.factory_ma: Quartz roofs combine with industrial cladding, narrow windows, loading areas, tanks, exhausts and maintenance pipework, with planting along the roads. Halls provide architecture and position markers; build the actual machines yourself.
modernspace.create_world_plot.factory_pr: A 2000×2000 quartz factory preset with large halls arranged by machine tier and process, including full module clearance.
modernspace.create_world_plot.file_ae_hi: The central core and shared production areas provide space for storage, crafting and small machines.
modernspace.create_world_plot.file_autho: This preset has fixed halls and an independent identity for generation, search and teleport targets.
modernspace.create_world_plot.file_contr: Virtual markers locate machine controllers; reservations already include every module and extension at maximum size.
modernspace.create_world_plot.file_distr: Architecture is fixed; machine plots are computed from the GregTech multiblocks when GregTech Odyssey is installed.
modernspace.create_world_plot.file_mater: The selected preset supplies its architecture and materials; build the actual machines yourself.
modernspace.create_world_plot.height_cus: Set surface and bedrock heights freely. The space between is filled with your selected concrete.
modernspace.create_world_plot.invalid_ma: %s: enter a valid solid block ID
modernspace.create_world_plot.invalid_se: Invalid values: check size, road, markings and height; showing last valid preview
modernspace.create_world_plot.lane_marki: Lane markings lie on roads between plots. Crosswalks also include dashed lines; double lines require a half-road width of at least 2.
modernspace.create_world_plot.marker_aut: 0=Auto: four lamps for odd chunk groups, one for even. 1–5=custom side length. Per-chunk auto markers use four lamps.
modernspace.create_world_plot.markings_u: This layout has no road surface. Choose a road layout to enable lane markings.
modernspace.create_world_plot.palette_hi: Select a swatch to apply it and update both previews.
modernspace.create_world_plot.pink_dream: The central 160-block AE hub stays open. Shared workshops on all four sides face inward, with walks reaching the center.
Bold Dream Home now has a re-planned pink district, lollipop markers, cherry gardens and bow lamps. Changing presets does not rewrite existing private dimensions.
Virtual markers locate machine controllers; build the machines yourself. Modules count only in their host envelope, megastructures stay open-air, and scenery avoids every reserved machine volume.
Clear streets and gardens define the districts; oversized halls are reduced, and megastructures remain open-air with spacious forecourts.
A 1500×1500 pink-and-white fantasy district with lollipops, bows, heart pools, cherry blossoms and dessert gardens.
Pink, cream, quartz and cherry wood shape lollipops, bows, heart gardens and dessert pavilions; megastructures remain outdoors.
